correctionsToPriorDocs: No fixed maximum container runtime; setInactivityTimeout caps the post-DO-silence window at 6 h and platform events can stop an instance at any time.
exec() has no built-in timeout; the 30 s figure was an SDK default, not a platform limit.
Cold start commonly 1-3 s (image size and entrypoint dependent).
Cancellation is by process handle only; kill() misses grandchild processes; a DO restart loses the handle.
Cancelling the starting request does not stop the process, and a client retry runs a second copy (documented) — evidence for no-retry / no-replay.
pty is supported (pty: true | {cols, rows}, resize), stderr forced to combined under pty.
Snapshots: writable rootfs only, immutable, 20 GB max, 30-day TTL, same image, public beta, excludes mounted filesystems.
Platform DirectoryBackup limit is about 156 GiB compressed (16 MiB parts x 10,000), not the 50 MB product limit used by pi-durable.

SSH exists as an operator path (wrangler containers ssh, Cloudflare-account authentication, no public port, does not keep a container alive); it is not a programmatic control channel and does not replace a worker or daemon.
nits: Canvas is 1250x920 both scenes; PNGs are 1290x960 because take_screenshot adds 20 px padding per side, so no height cap applies under 1920x1080.
Text is Comic Shanns fontFamily 8 with advance = 0.550 x fontSize (measured on a scratch scene before layout, not guessed); layouts use a 34 px line pitch so text boxes never overlap.
Only two font sizes are used: 38 (title) and 26 (everything else), so the font audit has no 22/24 px exceptions.
Scene A drops drawn arrows from the storage column to avoid crossing the centre panel; the storage cards carry a text line saying who writes them instead.
Scene B shows the three side-rail connectors as short diagonal arrows in the 70 px gutter (intent markers, cancel, Unknown); no labels are attached to keep text from overlapping card borders.
Three superseded/scratch scenes were deleted from the collection after the final two were verified; only the two recorded scene IDs remain.
Scenes were written through the Excalidraw MCP endpoint and verified with get_scene_content plus two identical screenshot passes; the DSH take_screenshot tool returns the same bytes for both scenes.
The issue-section file is a local draft only: no GitHub write, no PATCH, and issue #545 was not opened or modified.
